baseline.name: B0_BASE70
baseline.features: 64 selected source features plus taker_Z_h and taker_V_h for h=1,5,15 minutes
baseline.source_selection: 64-feature generator/feature selection and LightGBM tuning used the full development period; six taker_Z/V features were added in the 2026-10-18 development comparison
baseline.selection_independence: all reported validation is conditional on this previously selected feature set and hyperparameters; it is not independent OOS for the complete baseline selection procedure
baseline.target_definition: Close[Opened+6m] >= Open[Opened+2m]; five one-minute candles; ties resolve UP; label available at Opened+7m
baseline.decision_definition: nominal_decision_at = Opened+1m; last closed candle is the row opened one minute earlier
baseline.feature_availability: OHLCV close-event time is Opened+1m; actual historical feed receive timestamps are not available in the source dataset

training_weights.qualification: source BASE70 shared complete-feature mask; target label must be available by the fit boundary

split.training_purge: target_label_available_at <= first nominal_decision_at in the prediction block
split.existing_fold_decision: the saved BASE70 folds use a rolling approximately three-year training span and do not satisfy the project whole-history baseline; this experiment freezes a new one-path split before search
split.confirmation_policy: one frozen A/B/C comparison; no Optuna or portfolio reselection after confirmation begins

screening.method: regularized logistic correction of OOS BASE70 logit with compressed ESN states
screening.acceptance: mean incremental delta_logloss > 0 and positive delta for at least two of three common seeds

dynamic_diagnostics.saturation_definition: fraction of sampled state values with abs(state) >= 0.98

search.dense_and_ring_connectivity: fixed by topology; ring has two neighbors, dense uses all weights
search.downstream_promotion_rule: only if the linear screen selected no member: allow the highest fixed-budget candidate with positive mean search-validation LightGBM delta and positive delta on at least two of three seeds; promote at most one
search.resume: Optuna SQLite study plus identity-checked atomic stage files

nvar_control.quadratic_terms: upper triangle including squares of current eight standardized inputs

variants: B: BASE70 plus the selected ESN portfolio, or BASE70 if no ESN candidate passes
C: BASE70 plus four lags and 36 current quadratic NVAR terms
final_comparison.lightgbm_settings: same frozen parameters, rounds, training rows, weights, and common seed set for A/B/C
final_comparison.uncertainty: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over seven-day UTC blocks; 2000 replicates; conditional on the selected procedure
